title: COMMAND THE NEW WEEK WITH AGGRESSIVE MONDAY MORNING PRAYER BEFORE THE ENEMY DOES
text: Hallelujah. Hallelujah. Hallelujah. Oh, we worship you, Father. We worship you, Lord. We give you praise. We give you glory. We give you honor. There is none like you. There is none beside you. You are the alpha and the omega. You are the beginning and the end. You are the one who was, the one who is, and the one who is to come. And we bow before you this Monday morning. We bow before you at the threshold of a new week. And we say, "Father, have your way. Have your way in this place. Have your way in our lives. Have your way over every situation, every circumstance, every battle, every contention. Lord, we hand it all to you." Thank you, Father. Thank you, Lord. We receive grace to pray. We receive grace to decree. We receive grace to take charge of this week by the authority invested in us by the finished work of Christ. Thank you, [music] Lord. In Jesus' mighty name. Before we go into this time of prayer and administration, I want you to do something for me. I want you to share this broadcast. Share it right now. Send the link to someone. Send it to your family WhatsApp group. >> [music] >> Send it to that friend who has been going through a difficult season. You don't know what the spirit of God is about to do. You may be the instrument that God uses to redirect somebody's entire week, somebody's entire month, somebody's entire destiny. Don't sit on this. Share it. Let somebody else step into this atmosphere. The anointing that is about to flow in this place, God did not release it for you alone. Let it touch somebody. Let it reach somebody who is about to give up. Let it reach somebody who doesn't even know they need this prayer until they hear it. Do it now. And then come back with your whole heart because the spirit of God is about to move in a dimension that will mark this week for you permanently. Now, listen carefully. I want to teach you something before we pray because prayer without understanding is energy without direction, and many believers enter their week like passengers. They sit in the vehicle of the week, and they allow the week to take them wherever it wants, but that is not what God designed for you. That is not the posture of a son, that is not the posture of a daughter of Zion. You are not a passenger in this week, you are a driver. You are an authority, you are a legislator in the realm of the spirit, and this Monday morning is not just another day, it is a gate. It is a portal, it is the entrance to 7 days of divine activity, and whoever commands this gate controls what enters and what exits your life for the next 7 days. The book of Genesis chapter 1 verses 3 through 5, the Bible says, "And God said, let there be light, and there was light." And God saw the light that it was good, and God divided the light from the darkness, and God called the light day, and the darkness he called night, and the evening and the morning were the first day. Now, pay attention to the pattern. God spoke before the day was formed. He did not wait for the day to unfold and then react to it. He spoke into the void. He spoke into the formlessness. He spoke into the chaos, and what came out of his speaking was order, light, separation, identity, and purpose. That is the pattern of dominion. Dominion does not respond to what has already happened. Dominion speaks before things happen and determines the outcome. And Lamentations chapter 3 verses 22 through 23 says, "It is of the Lord's mercies that we are not consumed because his compassions fail not. They are new every morning. Great is thy faithfulness." There are dimensions to this. The mercies of God are new every morning, but the question is are you awake to receive them? Are you positioned to receive them? Because the enemy also understands the principle of the morning, the enemy also understands the principle of the gate. And if you don't command your morning, if you don't command the entrance of your week, something else will. Some other voice will. Some other altar will. Let me tell you something that many people don't understand. There are altars that are programmed to speak at specific times. There are altars in your father's house, there are altars in your village. There are altars tied to covenants that were made generations before you were born. And some [snorts] of those altars are programmed to speak at the beginning of every week. They are programmed to speak at the beginning of every month. They are programmed to release confusion, delay, accident, misunderstanding, [music] loss, sickness, and failure at very strategic times. And the reason some people experience consistent patterns of setback, every Monday something goes wrong, every beginning of the month something breaks, [music] every time they are about to have a breakthrough, something scatters. It is not coincidence. It is an altar speaking. It is a voice in the spirit realm issuing instructions against their destiny on schedule. And unless you rise up with a superior voice, the voice of the blood, the voice of the covenant, the voice of the Holy Ghost, and you silence that altar and command your week from the place of authority, you will keep living under a pattern that [music] God never designed for you. Thus sayeth the spirit of God, this is the morning that the cycle breaks. This is the Monday that the pattern is disrupted. This is the week that heaven invades what the enemy thought he had secured. And I don't care how long the pattern has been running. I don't care if it has been running for 5 years, 10 years, 20 years, 30 years. When the voice of God speaks, every other voice must be silent. When the blood of Jesus speaks, every altar must bow. And this morning we are not coming to God as beggars. We are coming to God as sons and daughters who know their rights. We are coming to God as people who understand covenant. And we are going to open our mouths and command this week with aggression, with fire, with authority, and with the backing of heaven. Look at what Isaiah chapter 45 verses 1 through 3 says. God said to Cyrus, "I will go before thee and make the crooked places straight. I will break in pieces the gates of brass and cut in sunder the bars of iron. And I will give thee the treasures of darkness and hidden riches of secret places that thou mayest know that I the Lord, which called thee by thy name, am the God of Israel." Do you see what God is saying? He says, "I will go before you." That means God is not working beside you this week. He's working ahead of you. He's going into your Monday before you get there. He's going into your Tuesday before the sun rises on Tuesday. He's going into your Wednesday, your Thursday, your Friday, your Saturday, your Sunday, and he's rearranging things. He's breaking gates of brass. He's cutting bars of iron. He's dismantling obstacles. He's removing hindrances. He's opening doors that no man can shut. And he's doing it before you arrive so that when you get there, what you meet is not resistance. What you meet is result. That is the God we serve. And this morning we are going to partner with what he's already doing by adding our voice to his activity. We are going to decree and declare. We are going to command and release. We are going to bind and loose, and by the time this prayer session is over, the trajectory of your entire week will have shifted. Now, I also want you to see Psalm 24:7-10. "Lift up your heads, O ye gates, and be ye lifted up, ye everlasting doors, and the King of glory shall come in." "Who is this King of glory? The Lord strong and mighty, the Lord mighty in battle. Lift up your heads, O ye gates, even lift them up, ye everlasting doors, and the King of glory shall come in." "Who is this King of glory? The Lord of hosts, he is the King of glory." This is not just a worship song, this is a command to the gates of the week. This is a command to the gates of your life. Lift up your heads, open, make way, the King of glory is coming through. And when the King of glory comes through the gate of your Monday morning, everything that has stationed itself at that gate to block you, every demon, every spirit, every assignment, every embargo, every enchantment must scatter, must scatter, must scatter in the name of Jesus. Those that seek me early, there is something about the early morning, there is something about being the first voice that speaks over your week, there is something about rising before the enemy rises. There is something about meeting God at the gate before the adversary stations himself there, and that is what you are doing right now. You are not late, you are not behind, you are right on time. The spirit of God orchestrated this moment, he brought you here, he drew you to this place of prayer, and now heaven is ready to move on your behalf. Can I tell you something? Somebody listening to me right now, this is not an ordinary Monday for you. The spirit of God is saying that this week carries your breakthrough. This week carries your testimony.
